notes.1.1: Line 1 is fragmentary; bꜣk.pl may be 'dues, labour' or 'servants'.
notes.1.7: m nꜥi̯.t ... m-kfꜣ, 'do not deal trustingly', is uncertain; nꜥi̯ may mean 'be at ease with'.

nodes.text: [...] [...] [...] electrum [...] the dues of Kush [...] the king's [son] [...] his [majesty], Usersatet.
Regnal year 23, fourth month of Akhet, day 1, the day of the festival of the king's appearance.
Copy of the order which His Majesty made with his own hands [...] [of] [Pharaoh(?)], may he live, prosper and be healthy, while he was sitting, drinking and making holiday [...]
Another matter for the king's son: do not deal trustingly with the Nubians; beware of their people and of their magicians.
